Project portfolio

Agentic systems

Neuro-symbolic tree tutor

A seven-agent learning system co-built with Niraj Chavan, combining symbolic validators, a prerequisite knowledge graph and Gemini explanations.

GeminiFastAPIReact / D3.js

Engineering case study

Make the rule behind a tree rotation visible.

Engineering decision

Rules validate the structure after a student action. The tutor uses the detected violation and prerequisite concepts to explain what went wrong.

Evaluation

The résumé reports detection of all structural violations in 240 test cases, with a mean validation latency of 34.1 ms. The pilot involved 23 users.

Scope

The tutor covers AVL trees, red-black trees, B-trees, B+ trees, heaps and segment trees. A React and D3.js interface connects to a FastAPI backend.
